text:
Drake Batherson made the week's funniest headline: asked about Sidney Crosby trade talk, Batherson said Crosby "can have my house" if he comes to the Senators, as Daily Faceoff put it. On the ice he has been busy too. He has 12 goals and 22 points in 24 games, two power-play goals last week, and Ottawa keeps winning.

The goals come with a warning. He has 12 on 7.8 expected, shooting 23% against 20% last season and a league rate near 13.5%. Finishing like that rarely lasts. Evolving-Hockey had him on the other side of that coin last season, worth more by chance quality than by goals, so his career probably sits somewhere in between.

He is a power-play shooter who can also set up teammates: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 89th percentile for shot assists. He also has 47 hits. His minutes slipped to 13.8 on Saturday against Los Angeles, his lowest of the last ten. We project about 72 points, a solid season for a former fourth-round pick.
headline: Batherson is finishing everything, and pitching Crosby
